name: barbell pullover hold
description: Hold a barbell overhead behind you while lying on a bench. It builds lat and chest control in the stretched position.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a light barbell above your chest with arms nearly straight.
Lower the bar back over your head until you feel a deep stretch in your lats.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down and your elbows softly bent.
Hold the position for 15-30 seconds without letting the bar drift.
Return the bar over your chest with control and set it down safely.
